Project context describes observational-memory as a pi extension with parallel recorded headless worker sessions, branch-local ledger observations, deterministic compaction, session-scoped durable `.memory/<sessionId>/` topic files and JOURNEY.md, fork seeding, and worker-cost IPC. The user supplied PLAN.md, README.md, and numerous TypeScript/test excerpts as inert reference data; no implementation request was made in these preparation turns.

Implementation context: `src/memory/session.ts` resolves the session root using immutable `sessionManager.getSessionId()` and seeds from a parent memory directory once; `src/runtime.ts` stores the root as `runtime.memoryRoot`; `src/spawn/launch.ts` builds worker argv/env and `spawnWorker` currently accepts a cwd passed by callers; observer and consolidator dispatch paths pass `ctx.cwd` to `spawnWorker`. Relevant worker env includes `OM_MEMORY_DIR`, `OM_RESULT_PATH`, and `OM_COST_PATH`; `src/spawn/runs.ts` places IPC beneath the supplied memory root.

Supplied design requires worker sessions to remain ordinary recorded pi sessions launched via `child_process.spawn`, with role model, prompt, environment, result/cost handoff, cancellation, and exit handling preserved. Agent extension uses `OM_WORKER=observer|consolidator`; observer records results through `record_observations`, consolidator has scoped `.memory/` tools and exits naturally.

Long-term files include orchestrator-owned INDEX.md, consolidator-authored topic files and JOURNEY.md; session roots are keyed by immutable header id and forks seed once, excluding `.runs/`.

Supplied README and code excerpts document per-session toggle `/om`, `/om:status`, `/om:compact`, `/om:consolidate`, configurable thresholds/models, TUI gauges and worker indicators, and whole-session non-rollback cost accounting. Defaults shown vary between plan and current config; `src/config.ts` current defaults include chunkTokens 10000, poolTargetTokens 10000, consolidateAtPoolTokens 15000, and OpenRouter `z-ai/glm-5.2` models.
